English: African marigold (Tagetes erecta) – mbangimwitu. Use against: bacteria, fungi, nematodes, insects (ants, beetles and many others). Preparation: crush 100-200g of the leaves, roots or flowers, pour on 1 litre of boiling water, stir, and soak for 24 hours, then add 1 litre of cold water. Spray on plants or into the soil.
Kiswahili: African marigold / Mbangimwitu (Tagetes erecta). Inazuia: bacteria, fungi, nematodes, wadudu (ants, beetles na wadudu wengine wengi). Kutayarisha: ponda gramu 100-200 ya matawi, mizizi na maua; mwaga kwa lita moja ya maji yaliyochemka; lowa kwa masaa ishirini na nne; ongeza lita moja ya maji baridi; nyunyiza kwa mimea au mchanga.
Source: https://infonet-biovision.org/tof-issue-no-17-septoct-2006-plant-extract-special-english-version (EN) / https://infonet-biovision.org/tof-issue-no-17-septoct-2006-plant-extract-special-swahili-version (SW)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=magazine; urgency=low; source_pair=true

English: Sweet potato (Ipomoea batatas) – kiazi kitamu. Use against: rice brown leaf spot, rice blast and other fungal diseases, insects (aphids). Preparation: crush and soak leaves in water, use as spray. Heavily starched water after cooking can be sprayed on small insects such as aphids.
Kiswahili: Sweet Potato / Kiazi kitamu (Ipomea batatas). Inazuia: rice brown leaf spot, rice blast na magonjwa mengine ya ukungu, wadudu (aphids). Kutayarisha: ponda na ulowe majani kwa maji, nyunyiza. Maji yanayo wanga mzito baada ya kupika yanaweza kunyunyizwa kwa wadudu wadogo kama aphids.
Source: https://infonet-biovision.org/tof-issue-no-17-septoct-2006-plant-extract-special-english-version (EN) / https://infonet-biovision.org/tof-issue-no-17-septoct-2006-plant-extract-special-swahili-version (SW)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=magazine; urgency=low; source_pair=true

English: Tea (Camellia sinensis) – chai. Use against: fungal diseases, insects, snails (woolly aphid, squash bug, termite mounds). Preparation: the used leaves can be spread around plants to repel snails. The liquid (tea), when cool, can be sprayed on plants.

English: When crops are damaged during or after harvest, they quickly spoil. You may not be able to sell your damaged produce, or you may be forced to sell at a reduced price. On the other hand, if you can reduce your losses, you can increase your income. At harvest time, when picking fruits, be careful not to knock them off the tree and onto the ground. If fruit falls, it gets bruised, disease and insects attack, and the fruit will quickly spoil. If you reduce the number of falls, you will have high quality produce to sell.
Kiswahili: Mazao yanapojeruhiwa wakati wa kuvuna au mara baada ya mavuno, yanaharibika kwa haraka. Unaweza kushindwa kuuza mazao yaliyoharibika au kujeruhiwa, na wakati mwingine ukalazimika kuyauza kwa bei ndogo. Kwa upande mwingine, kama utafanikiwa kupunguza hasara, unaweza pia kuongeza kipato chako. Wakati wa mavuno, unapokuwa ukichuma matunda, kuwa mwangalifu, usiyagonge kwenye mti au kuyaacha yakaanguka ardhini. Kama tunda likianguka chini, linaweza kupata michubuko, magonjwa na vijidudu vinalishambulia, na tunda huharibika. Kama utaweza kuzuia idadi ya matunda yanayoanguka chini, utakuwa na bidhaa bora sokoni.
Source: https://scripts.farmradio.fm/radio-script/avoid-post-harvest-losses-with-proper-handling/ (EN) / https://scripts.farmradio.fm/sw/mwongozo-wa-redio/epuka-hasara-baada-ya-mavuno-kwa-kutunza-mazao-yako-vizuri/ (SW) — Radio Spot #1 of 4, trimmed from full script

English: When crops are damaged during or after harvest, they quickly spoil, so you may be forced to sell at a reduced price. The best time to harvest fruits and vegetables is in the morning — wait until the dew has evaporated, then harvest before the day gets too hot. Harvesting later in the day leaves fruits and vegetables wilted or limp, with more disease and insect problems. Harvest in the morning for firmer, fresher produce.
Kiswahili: Matunda yanapokuwa yamejeruhiwa wakati wa kuvuna ama baada ya kuvuna, huharibika kwa haraka, hivyo unaweza kulazimika kuyauza kwa bei ya chini. Muda mzuri wa kuvuna matunda na mboga ni asubuhi — subiri mpaka umande umekauka, halafu vuna kabla jua halijawa kali. Ukivuna wakati wa jua kali, matunda na mboga zinaweza kusinyaa au kunyauka, na kushambuliwa zaidi na magonjwa au wadudu. Vuna asubuhi ili upate mazao mazuri na imara.
Source: https://scripts.farmradio.fm/radio-script/avoid-post-harvest-losses-with-proper-handling/ (EN) / https://scripts.farmradio.fm/sw/mwongozo-wa-redio/epuka-hasara-baada-ya-mavuno-kwa-kutunza-mazao-yako-vizuri/ (SW) — Radio Spot #2 of 4, trimmed from full script

Source: Rwanda MINEMA National Contingency Plan for Drought Hazard (minema.gov.rw/fileadmin/user_upload/Minema/Publications/Contingency_Plans/National_Drought_Contingency_Plan.pdf)

English: Increase agricultural production in regions less affected by drought to stabilize overall food supply.
Kiswahili: Ongeza uzalishaji wa kilimo katika maeneo yasiyoathiriwa sana na ukame ili kuimarisha upatikanaji wa jumla wa chakula.
Source: Rwanda MINEMA National Contingency Plan for Drought Hazard (minema.gov.rw/fileadmin/user_upload/Minema/Publications/Contingency_Plans/National_Drought_Contingency_Plan.pdf)

English: Increase harvest storage to ensure food security during droughts by preserving surplus from productive regions, reducing post-harvest losses, and enabling rapid distribution to affected areas.
Kiswahili: Ongeza uwezo wa kuhifadhi mavuno ili kuhakikisha usalama wa chakula wakati wa ukame kwa kuhifadhi ziada kutoka maeneo yenye uzalishaji mzuri, kupunguza upotevu baada ya mavuno, na kuwezesha usambazaji wa haraka kwa maeneo yaliyoathirika.
Source: Rwanda MINEMA National Contingency Plan for Drought Hazard (minema.gov.rw/fileadmin/user_upload/Minema/Publications/Contingency_Plans/National_Drought_Contingency_Plan.pdf)

Kiswahili: Wakulima wa Zambia wanahimizwa kujua jinsi ya kutambua dalili za ugonjwa wa mikanda ya kahawia ya muhogo kwenye mizizi, mashina, na majani yaliyoathirika, na kujua mahali pa kupata mbegu za muhogo zisizo na ugonjwa.

Kiswahili: Wakulima wa mboga wanapaswa kununua mbegu zilizothibitishwa na zilizotibiwa, isipokuwa wanapolima kwa njia ya kikaboni, ambapo mbegu haziwezi kutibiwa.

Kiswahili: Wakulima wanapaswa kushauriana na daktari wa mifugo au mtaalamu wa mifugo kabla ya kutumia Aloe Vera kutibu kuhara kwa kuku, ingawa mmea huo unatumika sana kusaidia kupona kutoka kwa ugonjwa.

English: Farmers using chemical pesticides against Fall armyworm should know when and how to use them safely, and how to store and clean the equipment and protective wear, to protect themselves, their families, and their communities.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanaotumia viuatilifu vya kemikali dhidi ya Fall Armyworm wanapaswa kujua wakati na jinsi ya kuvitumia kwa usalama, na jinsi ya kuhifadhi na kusafisha vifaa na mavazi ya kujikinga, ili kujilinda wao wenyewe, familia zao, na jamii zao.

English: For maize, support grain filling and monitor ear development to manage low pollination stress.
Kiswahili: Kwa mahindi, saidia ujazaji wa punje na fuatilia ukuaji wa vishala ili kudhibiti mkazo mdogo wa uchavushaji.

English: For rice, optimize water use to support grain filling and manage flowering.
Kiswahili: Kwa mpunga, boresha matumizi ya maji ili kusaidia ujazaji wa punje na kudhibiti kutoa maua.
Source: Ghana Meteorological Agency (GMet), Dekadal Agromet Bulletin, June 3rd Dekad 2025 (meteo.gov.gh/documents/5893/AGROMET_BULLETIN_JUNE_3RD_DEKAD_2025.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=government bulletin; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Ghana

English: Farmers, herders, water resource managers, and relevant authorities are advised to invest in high-yielding, water-tolerant crops, such as rice and tubers.
Kiswahili: Wakulima, wafugaji, wasimamizi wa rasilimali za maji, na mamlaka husika wanashauriwa kuwekeza katika mazao yenye mavuno mengi na yanayostahimili maji, kama vile mpunga na mizizi.
Source: The Gambia Dept. of Water Resources / MoFWR, Early Warning Bulletin for Food Security, 2025 Rainy Season Outlook (meteogambia.gm/documents/511/May_3__2025_Cah5bfw.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=government bulletin; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Gambia

English: Promote irrigated agriculture, particularly in the floodplains of the River Gambia, while carefully managing flood risks.
Kiswahili: Kuza kilimo cha umwagiliaji, hasa katika maeneo tambarare yanayofurika ya Mto Gambia, huku ukisimamia kwa makini hatari za mafuriko.
Source: The Gambia Dept. of Water Resources / MoFWR, Early Warning Bulletin for Food Security, 2025 Rainy Season Outlook (meteogambia.gm/documents/511/May_3__2025_Cah5bfw.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=government bulletin; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Gambia

English: Deploy climate-smart agricultural practices to enhance yields of both crops and fodder, especially methods that effectively manage excess rainfall.
Kiswahili: Tumia mbinu za kilimo kinachohimili mabadiliko ya tabianchi ili kuongeza mavuno ya mazao na malisho, hasa mbinu zinazodhibiti vyema mvua ya ziada.
Source: The Gambia Dept. of Water Resources / MoFWR, Early Warning Bulletin for Food Security, 2025 Rainy Season Outlook (meteogambia.gm/documents/511/May_3__2025_Cah5bfw.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=government bulletin; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Gambia

English: As rainfall increases and soils become saturated, farmers are encouraged to properly prepare their fields to reduce the risk of flooding and minimize damage to crops, including creating drainage channels where possible to prevent waterlogging.
Kiswahili: Mvua inapoongezeka na udongo kujaa maji, wakulima wanahimizwa kuandaa mashamba yao vizuri ili kupunguza hatari ya mafuriko na kupunguza uharibifu wa mazao, ikiwa ni pamoja na kutengeneza mifereji ya maji pale inapowezekana ili kuzuia kujaa kwa maji.
Source: Liberia Meteorological Service, Dekadal Early Warning Bulletin, Sept 2025 (meteoliberia.com/documents/22/DEKA3_SEPT_2025_VS68EWB.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=government bulletin; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Liberia

English: Farmers are encouraged to plant water-resistant or flood-tolerant crop varieties to reduce losses, and to monitor crops regularly for signs of disease or stress caused by excess moisture.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kupanda aina za mazao zinazostahimili maji au mafuriko ili kupunguza hasara, na kufuatilia mazao mara kwa mara kwa dalili za magonjwa au mkazo unaosababishwa na unyevu kupita kiasi.
Source: Liberia Meteorological Service, Dekadal Early Warning Bulletin, Sept 2025 (meteoliberia.com/documents/22/DEKA3_SEPT_2025_VS68EWB.pdf)
Metadata: tone=advisory; platform=government bulletin; urgency=medium; translation=team; source_lang=en; country=Liberia

English: Farmers are encouraged to move animals to higher ground to avoid flooding and reduce the risk of waterborne diseases, and to ensure animals are well-housed and hygienic to prevent disease outbreaks.
Kiswahili: Wakulima wanahimizwa kuhamisha wanyama kwenda maeneo ya juu ili kuepuka mafuriko na kupunguza hatari ya magonjwa yatokanayo na maji, na kuhakikisha wanyama wanahifadhiwa vizuri na kwa usafi ili kuzuia mlipuko wa magonjwa.
Source: Liberia Meteorological Service, Dekadal Early Warning Bulletin, Sept 2025 (meteoliberia.com/documents/22/DEKA3_SEPT_2025_VS68EWB.pdf)
